...I thought everything would be fun once we'd dealt with Weiss...
strings.(샤이닉이 바닥에 엎어진 채로 '심심해'라고 쓰고 있다. 그 모습이 익숙: (Shynic lies sprawled on the ground, writing 'I'm bored.' Used to this sight, Melvic pokes her shoulder with a small stick.)
strings.샤이닉 님, 타르타로스 한바퀴 뛰실래요?: Lady Shynic, would you like to run a lap around Tartaros?
Then is there anything you've wanted to do? Something out of the ordinary?
Who knows? Something I want to do... I've never really made plans for my life...
You said you had plenty to do from now on.
strings.그건 내가 하고 싶은 일이 아니지만, 해야 하는 일이라서…. 그래도 당장: Those are things I have to do, not things I want to do... And not right away. Io and old Ziskad said they'd discuss it first.
strings.맘에 안들지만 쥬드 왕국도 엮여 있으니 그거 해결된 다음에 뭘 해도 하겠: I don't like it, but the Kingdom of Jude is involved too. I suppose nothing can happen until that's settled?
strings.%s 님, 오랜만에 뵙습니다. 그동안 잘 지내셨나요?: It's been a while, %s. Have you been well?
strings.멜빅, 잘 있었어요?: Have you been well too, Melvic?
strings.샤이닉 님께서 자리를 비우시는 동안, 타르타로스로 들어오려는 악마를 몇: Nothing much happened while Lady Shynic was away, apart from catching a few devils trying to enter Tartaros.
strings.아무래도 샤이닉 님이 계시지 않으시면 나락의 방에서 풍겨져 나오는 힘에: When Lady Shynic is absent, quite a few devils and demons are drawn to the power seeping from the Abyss Chamber. So I put them inside it.
You really are no ordinary butler.
Oh, right. Melvic, I've thought of a plan.
strings.역시 샤이닉 님! 그 계획이 뭔지 말씀해주실 수 있나요?: Splendid, Lady Shynic! May I ask what it is?
I need something, so I'm taking %s to look for it.
strings.자세한 건 가면서 이야기해줄게. 인사할 때 필요한 거라 네가 있어야 하니: I'll explain on the way. It's something I need to pay my respects, and I need you there.
strings.그러면 같이 가요. 어디로 가면 될까요?: Then let's go together. Where are we headed?
strings.그러게 어디로 갈까? 일단 프로즌에게 미리 이야기나 해보자♡: Good question. Where shall we go? Let's talk to Frozen first. ♡
Luu started acting differently. I wondered who it was. So it's you.
strings.이리스 님과의 이야기는 잘 끝났어?: Did your conversation with Lady Iris go well?
strings.프로즌, 방금 무슨 말 하려고 했어? 혹시 작아서 안 보였다던가, 작아서: What were you about to say, Frozen? Something like 'too small to see,' perhaps? Or 'too small to see'?
strings.누구보다 존재감이 크신 분께 제가 그런 소리를 할 리가 없지 않습니까?: How could I say such a thing about someone with a presence greater than anyone else's?
strings.(샤이닉이 프로즌의 반응에 감탄하더니 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다.): (Impressed by Frozen's response, Shynic turns to look at %s.)
strings.아하하…. 교황님께 업무로 시달리다 보니. 아, 이건 잊어주십쇼. 그런데: Ahaha... Working under the pope has taught me a few things. Ah, please forget I said that. What brings you here, Lady Shynic?
strings.저번처럼 메디아 님께 드릴 걸 찾으려고 하십니까?: Something for Lady Medea, as before?
strings.정말 우연히 약간의 감지 능력이 커졌을 뿐입니다. 벨로쉬 덕분이라고 해야: Quite by chance, my powers of perception improved a little. Perhaps I should thank Belosh...
strings.그에게서 빠져나온 신성력의 영향이 아예 없다고 할 순 없어. 게다가 루우: I can't say the divine power that escaped him had no effect. And Luu has grown heavier. My shoulder is suffering.
strings.(루우가 프로즌의 말을 듣다가 없던 미간을 만들어 찌푸린다.): (Listening to Frozen, Luu produces eyebrows it did not have before and furrows them.)
strings.루우, 다른 건 몰라도 무거워진 건 인정하자. 하하하. 하여튼, 샤이닉: Whatever else you may say, Luu, admit you've put on weight. Hahaha. Anyway, what are you looking for, Lady Shynic?
When I returned from the realm of the dead, I brought a flower with me. I need it. With that, I think I can pay my respects properly.
strings.꽃입니까? 연옥 안에서 아발론과 어울리지 않는 꽃을 본 것 같긴 합니다만: A flower? I believe I saw one in Purgatory that seemed out of place in Avalon...
Did the Angel of Chaos have it...? I'd better go and look.
strings.프로즌 님, 저 문들이 남아있네요? 저기 다시 들어갈 수 있는 건가요?: Frozen, those doors are still here. Can we go back inside?
strings.물론이지. 지금 아발론의 상태가 어떤 것 같아 보여?: Of course. What do you think of Avalon's condition now?
From what I felt on the way here... Hmm... I can't feel anything at all.
strings.저 문들은 아직도 남아있고, 그 안에도 들어갈 수 있어. 우리가 본 바니: The doors remain, and we can still enter. Vanitas and Purgatory look just as they did before. I was certain they were disappearing then.
strings.믿을 수 없겠지만, 사실이야. 바이스가 말했던 어떤 세계의 공간인지는 알: Hard to believe, but true. I don't know which world those spaces Weiss spoke of belong to...
strings.그래서 교단에 보고할 만한 물건을 찾고 있는데, 그런게 마땅히 보이지 않: So I've been looking for something to report to the order, but I haven't found anything suitable.
strings.그래서 가는 김에 %s에게 찾아달라는 거군. 의외로 물건을 잘 찾는 거: So you want %s to look while we're there. Apparently you're rather good at finding things?
strings.예전에 이면에서 뭔가 찾았다는 이야기를 들었습니다. 그렇다는 건, %s의: I heard about something you found on the other side before. Perhaps wherever you set foot, %s, new places and paths open.
strings.…어떤 길이 될지 모르지만, 그 길이 좋은 방향이었으면 좋겠어. 운명의: ...I don't know what path it will be, but I hope it leads somewhere good. Don't lose yourself at fate's crossroads...
strings.너는 믿는 곳을 향해 걸어가♡: Walk toward what you believe in. ♡
Beings like Weiss are still in this world. Others may come, too.
strings.샤이닉 님은 괜찮으십니까?: Will you be all right, Lady Shynic?
strings.어, 괜찮아. 쉽게 죽지는 않으니까♡ 들어간 김에 한 번에 다 찾았으면: Yes, I'm fine. I don't die easily. ♡ I hope we can find everything in one trip.
strings.그러게 말입니다. 제가 예전에 봉인해둔 편지 때문에 저 친구가 한 장소에: So do I. Because of those letters I sealed away before, this poor soul had to visit the same place over and over.
Lady Shynic, bring the flower to me and I will bless it in a different form.
strings.알았어. 죽음의 손길이 묻으면 시들어버릴 지도 모르니까. 그런데 계속 여: All right. The touch of death might make it wither. Will you stay here?
strings.네, 근처에서 교단에 제출할 증거품을 찾는 중이라…. 여기서 기다리고 있: Yes. I'm looking nearby for evidence to submit to the order. I'll wait here.
strings.빨리 끝내야겠다. 아발론에 오래 있고 싶진 않거든. 정말 귀찮단 말이지…: I'd better finish quickly. I don't want to linger in Avalon. It's such a bother...
strings.오셨습니까, 샤이닉 님? 즐겁게 오시는 걸 보니 물건은 찾으신 듯 하군요: Welcome back, Lady Shynic. From your cheerful step, I take it you found what you wanted.
Lady Shynic made a very good choice bringing you along.
This flower is rare and special, so make it even more special. ♡ Be careful with it.
strings.(프로즌이 안개꽃을 받아든 채로 눈을 감은 채 기도를 한다. 정령 루우가: (Holding the baby's breath, Frozen closes his eyes in prayer. The spirit Luu draws a tiny light from somewhere and guides it into the flower.)
Live long enough, and even a demigod gives you a blessing. Really...
(As Shynic accepts the baby's breath, its tiny petals drift free and turn into little lights, gathering around her as she watches in surprise.)
strings.사실 자신이 없었는데, 프로즌이 이걸 해주네. 그리움을 품은 마음이 있다: I wasn't sure it would work, but Frozen managed it. Light that transforms when the heart holds longing.
strings.성서에 이르길, 이 빛은 죽음을 떠나 그리워하는 자를 향한 마음이 있다면: The scriptures say this light is born of feelings for someone missed beyond death.
Send it toward the one you long for, Lady Shynic.
%s, I have a favor to ask.
strings.프로즌, 나중에 봐. 아, 좋은 일일 때만 와야 해. 데미갓이 찾아온다는: See you later, Frozen. Oh, visit only for good reasons. A demigod turning up usually means trouble, so make sure you only come with good news!
strings.(꿈꾸는 이들이라고는 전혀 없던 숲을 한참 동안 헤맨 후에야 샤이닉과 %: (After wandering for a long time through the forest, now entirely without dreamers, Shynic and %s finally stop.)
Yes. This is where I met the forest guardian and Eda.
strings.(샤이닉이 조용히 주위를 둘러보다가 초록색 잎과 노란 잎이 가득한 꽃밭을: (Shynic quietly surveys her surroundings, then notices a flower bed full of green and yellow leaves.)
No one's been tending them. Of course they've wilted.
strings.(샤이닉이 낮은 자세로 손을 뻗어 꽃잎을 만진다. 그러자 품에서 맴돌고: (Shynic crouches and reaches out to touch the petals. The lights hovering close to her gently descend onto the flower bed.)
strings.에다, 미안해. 네 이야기를 듣고 바로 왔어야 했는데, 이제야 오게 됐어: Eda, I'm sorry. I should have come as soon as I heard about you. But only now...
I'm so late, aren't I? Don't worry. I've kept your ribbon safe.
strings.(샤이닉이 오랫동안 꽃잎을 어루만지며 말을 잇지 못한다.): (For a long time, Shynic strokes the petals, unable to continue.)
strings.「미안해하지 마. 샤이닉은 잘못이 없으니까.」: 「Don't be sorry. You did nothing wrong, Shynic.」
strings.(뭐지? 기분 탓인가? 어디서 목소리가 들려오는 거지?): (What was that? Am I imagining it? Where did that voice come from?)
strings.오랜 시간 동안 잊고 지냈나 봐. 더 빨리 만날 수도 있었을 텐데…. 미: I suppose I forgot for so long. We could have met sooner... I'm sorry.
strings.지금은 좋은 친구들이 있으니까 다시 만나게 될 때까지 외롭지 않게 있을게: I have good friends now. I won't be lonely until we meet again. And...
strings.다시 만나게 되면…. 오래 전 그때처럼…. 심심하지 않게 내 친구가 되어: When we do meet again... just like long ago... be my friend, so I won't be bored.
strings.그래도 죽음에서 돌아올때, 안개꽃을 가지고 돌아와서 다행이야. 이렇게 마: I'm glad I brought the baby's breath back when I returned from death. It let me share my feelings like this...
strings.샤이닉 님, 괜찮아요?: Are you all right, Lady Shynic?
strings.안 괜찮으면 죽어줄 거야?: If I'm not, will you die for me?
No, but if you're saying things like that, I suppose you're all right.
Hehe. Let's go. Oh! I forgot.
strings.아까 비어있는 연옥에 갔을 때, 바니타스도 가야한다는 걸 깜박했어. 미안: When we went into the empty Purgatory earlier, I forgot we needed to visit Vanitas too. Sorry.
strings.불타는 수레바퀴를 수리해야 하는데, 거기에 수레바퀴랑 비슷한 느낌의 나무: I need to repair the Burning Wheel. Find wood there with a similar feel to the wheel, set it alight, cut it into suitable pieces, and put it in this.
strings.(샤이닉이 소재를 알 수 없는 자루 하나를 %s에게 건넨다.): (Shynic hands %s a sack made of an unfamiliar material.)
strings.수레바퀴를 수리하지 않으면 초보 여신님이 할 일이 많아져서 힘들어 할 거: If the wheel isn't repaired, our rookie goddess will be overwhelmed with work. Can you go now?
If that's what it's for, I'll go right away.
You always react immediately when it's about our rookie goddess.
Just bring one good piece of wood. One is enough.
I'll stay here a little longer, then return to Tartaros.
strings.(%s의 모습이 사라지자 샤이닉이 조용히 시든 꽃밭을 바라본다.): (After %s leaves, Shynic quietly looks at the withered flower bed.)
strings.꽃을 가져가서 타르타로스에 심고 싶은데, 잘 될까 모르겠네. 이 꽃이 타: I'd like to take these flowers and plant them in Tartaros. Would it work? Could they grow properly there?
Should I ask Medea? Oh, I don't know. Coming back would be a bother...
strings.(샤이닉이 멍하니 하늘을 바라다보며 중얼거린다.): (Shynic gazes absently at the sky and mutters.)
strings.초보 여신님♡ 나 여신님 찬스써도 돼? 친구 중에 꽃의 정령 있다고 했지: Rookie goddess. ♡ Can I call in a favor? You said one of your friends was a flower spirit, right?
strings.(샤이닉의 말이 끝나자 마자 꽃밭 위로 뭔가가 떨어진다. 잠시 후, 꽃밭: (No sooner has Shynic spoken than something falls onto the flower bed. A moment later, a girl covered in petals rises angrily among the flowers.)
strings.이리스, 니 갑작시리 내 보내면 혼난다!! 알았나?: Iris, ye can't just send me off without warning! Ye hear me?
strings.꽃향기가 나는 걸 보니 꽃의 정령을 보내주셨군. 너 정령 맞아?: That floral scent... She sent a flower spirit. You are a spirit, right?
Did ye call me? I'm no spirit who comes running just because someone calls.
strings.말투를 보니 고대 졍령이네. 믿고 부탁해도 되겠다♡ 나는 샤이닉. 타르타: An ancient spirit, judging by that accent. I can trust you with this favor. ♡ I'm Shynic, of Tartaros...
strings.내는 조에, 니 눈지 알고 있다. 모 도와주믄 되는데?: I'm Zoe. I know who ye are. What d'ye need help with?
strings.(평소 정적이었던 타르타로스가 시끄럽다. 공사라도 시작했는지 여기저기 흙: (The usually quiet Tartaros is noisy. Clouds of dust rise here and there, as though construction has begun.)
strings.쿨럭쿨럭. 타르타로스에 무슨 일이라도 있어요?: Cough, cough. Is something happening in Tartaros?
strings.그냥 오랜만에 움직여보려고. 그건 그렇고 내가 말한 건 가져왔어?: I just felt like doing something for once. Did you bring what I asked for?
strings.네, 여기요. 샤이닉 님 말대로 괜찮아 보이는 나무에 불을 붙이고, 조각: Yes, here. I found suitable wood, set it on fire, and cut it up, just as you said.
But this sack... It looks like the one I put Curiring in before...
strings.내가 그거 보고 대충 만들었어♡ 쓸만하지?: I saw that one and made a rough copy. ♡ Handy, isn't it?
strings.네, 되게 유용했어요. 그런데 불태워서 만든 목재요. 불타고 있는데, 이: Yes, very. But the wood I burned... It's still on fire, yet strangely it doesn't feel hot.
strings.다른 세계의 물건이라서 그래. 심지어 그 공간에서 이뤄지는 행동 또한 우: That's because it's from another world. Even actions in that space seem to work differently from our world.
strings.불타는 수레바퀴, 바니타스도…. 처음부터 바이스가 우리 세계에 오지 않았: The Burning Wheel, Vanitas... If Weiss had never come to our world, we'd never have had to go there.
Oh, who knows? I hate complicated things. ♡ It's already happened. What can we do?
So... I'll repair the wheel with this. Hehe.
strings.그야 할 일이 생겼으니까…. %s, 나 지금 재미있어. 덕분에 심심해질: Of course. I have something to do... %s, I'm having fun. Thanks to you, I don't think I'll be bored nearly as often.
Hehe. I'm glad you came to Tartaros.
strings.너는 너대로 해야 할 일이 있잖아. 나는 나대로 여기서 해야 할 일을 찾: You have your own work to do. I'll find things I need to do here. So come to visit, not to help. All right?
Now I sound like Io. Melvic, put that here.
strings.네, 샤이닉 님. 어, %s 님 오셨나요?: Yes, Lady Shynic. Oh, you're back, %s?
Lady Shynic returned with a great many flower seedlings she intends to plant.
...I don't know how many there are, but more than enough to fill Tartaros.
strings.(오네이로 숲에서 봤던 건데…. 분명 시들어있었는데, 어떻게 살린거지?): (Those are the flowers from Oneiro Forest... They were wilted. How did she revive them?)
I called in our rookie goddess' friend, didn't I?
strings.정렁, 정렁 하는 고대 정령이 내 말 들어주고 돌아갔어. 저 꽃이 지금: That ancient spirit with the funny accent helped me and went home. Those flowers are my task now.
strings.(샤이닉이 환하게 웃으며 흙속에서 피어있는 꽃 한송이를 바라본다.): (Shynic smiles brightly at a flower blooming in the soil.)
strings.멜빅, 이제 여길 다 꽃으로 채울 거야. 내 힘이 꽃을 피울거라고♡ 이젠: Melvic, we're going to fill this whole place with flowers. My power will make them bloom. ♡ I want to give life now, instead of taking it.
strings.도와주러 오지 말고, 놀러오라고 말씀하신지 얼마 안된거 같은데요?: Didn't you just tell me to come and visit rather than help?
strings.그건 다음부터야! 오늘은 도와달라고!: That's from next time! Help me today!
strings.얼마나 하면 될까요?: How much planting are we talking about?
strings.타르타로스 끝부터 끝까지?: From one end of Tartaros to the other?
strings.샤이닉 님이 이렇게 의욕을 보이시는 게 얼마만인지…. 저도 살다보니 이런: It's been so long since Lady Shynic was this enthusiastic... I never thought I'd live to see the day.
Cheeky words from someone so young.
Lady Shynic, I am the oldest in this town after you. Hehe.
strings.언제였더라, 이 녀석을 발견하고 치료해주고 데려왔던 게…. 멜빅, 이야기: When was it that I found this boy, healed him, and brought him here...? Melvic, this could be a long story. Let's take a break.
Of course. I expected as much, so I prepared refreshments.
strings.(멜빅이 들고 있던 피크닉 바구니를 열어 샤이닉과 %s의 앞에 음료와 간: (Melvic opens his picnic basket and sets out drinks and light refreshments for Shynic and %s.)
strings.(샤이닉이 만족스러운 표정으로 음료를 마신 후, 오래 전 멜빅과 만났던: (After taking a satisfied sip, Shynic begins the story of how she met Melvic long ago.)
strings.(메디아와 함께 어떤 마을에서 죽어가는 멜빅을 발견했고, 살리기 위해 신: (How she and Medea found him dying in a village, and went to Divine Tree Lapier to save him.)
strings.(샤이닉은 그것만으로 부족했는지 아무에게도, 심지어 멜빅에게조차 하지 않: (As though that were not enough, Shynic continues sharing old stories she has never told anyone, not even Melvic.)
strings.(모든 일이 재미없다고 생각했었던 소녀가 있었다. 새로운 만남과 이별,: (There was once a girl who found nothing interesting. Through new meetings and farewells, in what may have been only a brief span of her life, that girl had certainly changed.)
strings.그러면 즐겁게 해보자! 재미있는 일이 될 거야!: Now, let's enjoy ourselves! This is going to be fun!
